lines.en: I knock on Molly’s door and wait for her to answer.
I can hear a slight rustling inside of the room, so if she’s not in there it’s either Tsuneyo or...
An intruder.
: Okay, intruder. Get out of Molly’s room.
Another few seconds go by without an answer, I begin to suspect that either Molly has her headphones on or is just knowingly avoiding me for some reason.
No one avoids me during my free time and gets away with it.
Especially not someone like Molly MacCormack.
If that actually is her inside of the room and not Tsuneyo or an intruder.
: Open up. I can hear you in there.
I press my ear against the door to confirm that I did actually hear something moments ago...and I can’t really tell if I did or not.
It's definitely quiet now.
That doesn’t put an end to my curiosity, though.
Maybe I should try going in?
What should I do?
Open the door
Obviously I’m going to try and open the door.
Don’t not open the door
Obviously I’m not going to not open the door.
There was always only one choice.
I push the door open, hoping that if it is an intruder inside that they also happen to be wearing headphones for some mysterious reason.
That way, I’d be able to take them down before-
: Oh.
: Nh...hah...mm~
Well, then.
I suppose I should have seen this coming given Molly’s tendency to discuss erotic games and things like that.
But it seems a little early in her route for something like this to happen.
Hah. Look at me, calling this her “route.”
I bet she’d be proud of me if she wasn’t too busy fingering herself to-
: Uh-oh.
Well...that’s something I’m probably going to have to pretend I didn’t see.
In fact, this entire event is something I should probably pretend I never saw.
But...
: Ngh~
: Mm...mm...ahh...
Yeah, I’m not leaving any time soon.
Molly’s heel presses against her desk and causes her monitors to sway back and forth.
If she had her eyes open, I imagine she’d have a panic attack. Those things look kind of expensive.
The sound coming from her headphones is definitely porn, but...
I don’t really think I’d call what I see on the screen porn.
She’s quiet and gentle enough that I can just barely hear the slight squelching of her fingers sliding in and out of her.
She’s probably worried that someone outside of the room will hear, so she’s doing her best to not make any noise.
I doubt she really took into consideration anyone inside of the room, though.
What if it was Tsuneyo who walked in instead of me? How would she properly explain this to her?
I should give Molly a lecture about locking the door once she finishes masturbating.
: Ah...hah...aaaahh~
: Hah...mmf...f...fuck...
Molly’s voice is a lot different from normal right now.
I mean, it’s not uncommon for things like that to happen to people during times like this, but it’s like hers jumped up two or three full octaves.
I’m already turned on from just watching for the last few seconds, but...
I still haven’t even decided if I want to reveal my presence, let alone try and push my luck by joining in on the fun.
There’s obviously no way Molly would be up for anything more than she’s doing right now...
I mean, in her mind, she’s alone.
: Aaaah~
The video Molly has minimized in the background grows louder.
I’ve also confirmed that it’s likely some sort of hentai video because I have never watched normal porn with these sorts of sound effects before.
As the video grows louder, so does Molly.
Her breaths become more rapid and her fingers move quicker.
But even if the sight of her meticulously yet roughly pleasuring herself wasn’t enough to tip off that she’s getting close to climaxing, the way she curls her toes would.
She rocks back and forth in her chair, groping her chest and stopping every few seconds to catch her breath.
: Ngh...
: Hah...ahhh~
: Ahhh...yes...yes...
: Right there...right there...
Ooooh, so she talks to herself while she does this as well.
That’s totally not a creepy thing for me to casually say to myself after waltzing into her room and watching her [masturbate] for several minutes straight.
I’m sure she’d make the same astute observation if she walked in on me and...that was actually a thing I did.
: Hah...yes yes yes...
: Right there...
: Ahhhh~
: Aaaaahhhhh~ hah...hah...ahhh...
: Gonna...cum...
: Just...a little harder...and...
: Mmmmmmmm!!~~~~
: Mm...mmm...hmm...
Molly covers her mouth as a very quick orgasm sweeps over her, timed perfectly with the one leaking out of her headphones.
She gently continues to caress herself, still catching her breath, when a genius idea that I will absolutely not regret pops into my head.
Why just slip out of the room unnoticed when I can walk up to her and make her aware of my presence, forever ingraining this moment into her subconscious?
: Ahh...hah...
: Ahhhhh~
Actually, maybe this wouldn’t be the most embarrassing thing to ever happen to Molly?
I mean, she is a degenerate, isn’t she?
There’s no way she hasn’t been caught masturbating before.
Hell, she probably even left the door unlocked so something like this would happen.
A wise man once said that you only live once.
That wise man was me, right here and right now.
If I believe in myself, there is no way this can backfire.
: Hey.
Or maybe this was a horrible idea and I’m about to give her a heart attack.
: What...
: What...
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!
: WHAT ARE YOU DOING IN HERE, SIR?! HOW DID YOU GET PAST THE BARRIER?!
: HOW MUCH DID YOU SEE?!
: WAIT! DON’T TELL ME HOW MUCH YOU SAW!
: I DON’T WANT TO KNOW!
: JUST SO YOU KNOW, ALL I’M DOING IS REPLENISHING MY MANA!
: IT IS A COMPLETELY NORMAL THING FOR DRUIDS MY AGE! WE ALL DO IT!
: So...I'm sorry for walking in on you.
: But, to be fair, there was no chance I was ever going to walk away from that.
: I AM FLATTERED BUT ALSO TERRIFIED! SO THANK YOU AND ALSO PLEASE LEAVE!
: For someone trying so hard to stay quiet, you’re sure yelling a lot right now.
: ME?! YELLING?! WHY WOULD I EVER YELL?!
: You know, Molly...you can always come to me for help if you-
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!
Out of nowhere-
Actually, not out of nowhere. I very much provoked this situation.
Suddenly, Molly jumps back in her chair and causes it to topple over.
Her foot connects with my face and I worry for a split second that I may need to purchase new glasses as a result.
: Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeehhhhhhhhhhhh...
: Sir?...Are you still there?...
: Yup.
: This is the most exciting night I’ve had in a while, actually.
: That’s nice...but can you...call a cleric?...
: I think my ribs are broken.
: Here, let me che-
: DO NOT TOUCH ME! NOT IN THIS STATE!
: But...
: I’m a cleric.
: Well then...maybe just a little bit...
: But please be...be gentle...
Did that actually work?
: Ugh...I’m not going to do anything to you, Molly.
: You don't actually think your ribs are broken, do you?
: Probably not, but...I’d be in much better shape if I could reequip my armor.
: As you may have inadvertently discovered...my mana is already low and...now my hp is low as well...
: So could I maybe...have a few minutes to myself, please?
: It’s my fault for...not making the barrier strong enough but...
: On a pure...personal level, I don’t really...want you to see me like this...
: Yeah. I’ll wait in the hallway for you to collect yourself.
: Thank you...
: Sir?
: Oh. Sorry.
: Come see me when you’re ready.
: Y...Yeah...
: Hah...
: I could have sworn I locked the door...
: Luck of the Irish, my arse.
: There’s no way he’s going to believe this was just a coincidence...
: Molly? Are you coming?
: Y-Yes! Coming right now!
Molly comes out of the room several minutes later with an understandably flushed face.
She stands there awkwardly (And even more awkwardly than normal, since Molly always stands around awkwardly) and makes sure no one is around before finally speaking up.
: Soooooo...
: Please don’t tell her.
And here I was ready to just ignore the elephant in the room.
: You likely won’t believe this, Sir, but it really was just a coincidence.
: Well, kind of.
: You see, I was doing the normal things that...lower my mana pool and...left a tab with Instagram open and...
: Just wound up there...
: You really don’t need to tell me all that. I’m not going to say anything.
: I shouldn’t have been there in the first place.
: Wait, that’s right! I have the high ground here!
: You used illegal methods to break through the barrier!
: All I did was open the door.
: Illegal!
: If we were Yakuza, I’d have your pinky cut off!
: Spill some salt on a table, Sir! See what happens!
: I’m Irish and I know magic! I WILL DESTROY YOU!
: Gah...l didn’t think you’d see my raw character model this early. I’m still not happy with the...customization of some of it.
: The menu glitched out and the breast slider would only go up to 10.
: I have no idea what that means, but feel free to just forget about everything that’s happened in the last 30 minutes.
: I don’t play a class that can modify memory, Sir.
: And even if I did, that’s a fifth level enchantment.
: I’ll just live with shame and regret and go back to only replenishing my mana in the showers.
: Or just, you know, lock your door.
: I thought I did!
: I even heard you knocking and intentionally didn’t answer so you’d leave!
: So you did hear me.
: Yes! You knock very loudly, Sir!
: I’ll just use arcane lock from now on. That's what I should have done in the first place.
Yes, Molly. Rely on a magical lock. That’s sure to put an end to my perversion.
: It’s actually kind of weird, Sir.
: I’ve played a lot of games with scenes where the protagonist walks in on a girl...replenishing her mana...and certain things always transpire after that.
: But when it actually happened to me, I kicked you in the face and broke all of my ribs.
: I’m pretty sure your ribs are fine if you’re able to hold a conversation with me.
: That may be so, but rollback is disabled in real life and I’ll never know how things should have played out.
: Stupid teacher, passing through barriers undetected.
: I can’t wait until the devs find out and nerf you.
: Well, I know saying sorry won’t fix anything. But I’m sure we’ll look back on this in time and laugh about it.
: Perhaps if you had only seen me doing the thing.
: But my reluctance to close certain tabs has led to something that causes grave concern for me.
: So much so that my face is burning up just thinking about it.
: I’m not going to say anything about what I saw, Molly.
: It was just the one time, I swear.
: That’s fi-
: Okay, maybe it was more than one time.
: Again, that’s-
: AAAAAH FINE! I DO IT ALL THE TIME!
: SHE’S SO PRETTY AND...
: AND PERFECT...AND...
: AND-
: And...she won’t even look at me.
Uh-oh.
I didn’t expect to get into this right now.
: She didn’t talk to me for a whole week after the Christmas party, Sir.
: Am I that horrible?
: Is kissing me truly the worst thing in the entire world?
: And then...and then to top it all off, she went back to treating everything like normal right afterwards.
: Like it never even happened.
: How is that fair?
: Sure, it seemed like a joke at the time...but there was always the hope that maybe she’d notice me after that.
: Of course not, though. I mean-
: I’m Molly MacCormack.
: The Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest.
: A fully geared resto druid with every single “Ahead of the Curve” achievement.
: And a girl who has no use for actual human beings since they have no use for her!
: I don’t need anyone! I’m independent!
: I can do anything! Go anywhere!
: I can...
: I can-
: Okay, okay. Come here.
: AAAAAAAAAAHHHH!
: I HATE THIS SO MUCH! THIS IS EXACTLY WHY I PREFER 2D!
Molly lunges forward and buries her head into my chest.
It’s only a matter of seconds before I can feel her tears beginning to seep through my shirt.
Life is weird.
I started tonight by walking into her room uninvited, catching her in the act of pleasuring herself-
And now she’s crying and confessing feelings that I’m sure she wanted to keep locked away for as long as possible.
I guess being a degenerate pays off sometimes.

I let Molly cry for another minute or two, rubbing her bright orange hair and standing still, hoping none of the other girls on this floor come out and catch us in the middle of a strangely sentimental moment.
A strangely sentimental moment that only exists because I couldn't mind my own business.
What a time to be alive.
Molly goes back to normal eventually and retreats back into her dorm.
I need to assure her a few more times that I won’t say anything and, it takes a while, but I’m pretty sure she eventually believes me.
But now I can’t help but wonder if anything more will ever come of this.
Especially now that...something is going on between Rin and me.
What that something is, I have no idea.
But I hope that whatever it is, Molly will understand.
Rin’s been searching for love since the moment I met her.
But I guess that even someone who seems like a perfect match for her isn’t someone she should automatically just...want to be with.
Molly clearly has some feelings she needs to sort out- and so does Rin.
So does everybody.
Until then, though-
I guess I’ll just keep sneaking into girls' rooms and watching them finger themselves.
Just kidding.
I’ll obviously be there for Molly if she ever needs another shirt to cry into.
And next time, I won’t open the door if she doesn’t answer.
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!
